description: This file defines the ShippingOption class, representing shipping options with attributes such as price, name, code, delivery and shipping dates, description, and estimated delivery days, including getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ShippingOption
classes.description: A model class representing a shipping option with price, name, code, delivery/shipping dates, description, and estimated days, with methods to access and modify these properties.

methods.name: getOptionPrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the shipping option, converting from text if necessary.

methods.name: setOptionPrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionCode
methods.description: Sets the code identifier for the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionCode
methods.description: Retrieves the code identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the option's price.

methods.name: getOptionPriceText
methods.description: Retrieves the textual representation of the option's price.

methods.name: setOptionId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionDeliveryDate
methods.description: Sets the delivery date for the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionDeliveryDate
methods.description: Retrieves the delivery date for the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionShippingDate
methods.description: Sets the shipping date for the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionShippingDate
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping date for the shipping option.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the shipping option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description for the shipping option.

methods.name: setEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Sets the estimated number of days for delivery.

methods.name: getEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated number of days for delivery.

calls: org.slf4j.Logger.equals("Can't convert price text " + this.getOptionPriceText() + " to big decimal")
